meta.title: Fix static member exports to not instantiate declaring type
meta.body_summary: Fix MEF static member exports so the declaring type is not unnecessarily instantiated, improving performance and avoiding constructor side effects.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed static export instantiation with unit tests; AArnott required config reverts and MEF engine compatibility fixes before approving and merging.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 172 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, concentrated in two production files plus a test file. It fits a narrow framework performance fix that nevertheless required multiple interactive review rounds before eventual merge.

review_details.concern_detail: AArnott first requested reverting global.json/nuget.config changes and running tests against all MEF engines with MEFv2 attributes; a later CHANGES_REQUESTED required dropping MEFv2 attributes from static field/method tests because MEFv2 does not support exporting fields or methods.
review_details.performance_claim: Static member exports should not instantiate the declaring type, avoiding unnecessary constructor execution and performance overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The change required deep familiarity with MEF engine semantics and repository build configuration; Copilot needed multiple human-guided iterations to align tests and config changes with maintainer expectations.

detection_detail.code_reading: AArnott reviewed inline diff hunks and requested reverts of SDK/package source changes, broader MEF engine coverage, and removal of unsupported static member attributes.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Maintainer triggered Azure Pipelines multiple times via /azp run; CI execution is visible through azure-pipelines bot confirmations.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests verify constructor behavior for static field/property/method exports and mixed classes, but no benchmark or profiling data is provided for the performance overhead claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot iteratively reverted config changes, adjusted test attributes, and removed unsupported MEFv2 marks in response to CHANGES_REQUESTED feedback; maintainer fixed whitespace before merge.

core_change_summary.description: In ExportProvider.cs and RuntimeExportProviderFactory+RuntimeExportProvider.cs, static member exports now check MemberRef.IsStatic() and call GetValueFromMember(null, ...) directly, bypassing part lifecycle instantiation. Comprehensive tests were added in StaticMemberExportsTests.cs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Initial exploration temporarily changed global.json SDK version and nuget.config source; these were reverted during review.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and exploration commit modified global.json and nuget.config.
Core fix commit updated ExportProvider and RuntimeExportProvider to bypass instantiation for static members.
Test commit added coverage for static field, property, method, and mixed-class exports.
Review feedback led to reverting global.json/nuget.config and adding MEFv2 support to tests.
Subsequent commits removed redundant engine flags and unsupported MEFv2 attributes for static field/method exports.
Maintainer applied whitespace fix before final merge.
